function_summary: Small brushed DC motor with a plastic reduction gearbox for wheel-driven projects.
classification_reason: Motor or actuator component; requires structural links and mounts to become an arm or leg.
assembly_notes: One motor with wires; wheel, mounting, controller, motor driver and power are separate. No built-in encoder or position feedback.
evidence_note: Vendor describes TT wheel applications, one motor per order and the need for an external high-current driver.

function_summary: Compact position-controlled hobby servo for small mechanisms.
classification_reason: Motor or actuator component; requires structural links and mounts to become an arm or leg.
assembly_notes: Includes servo horns and mounting hardware; supply a controller, power and mechanism.
evidence_note: Vendor identifies TowerPro SG92R, approximate half-turn motion and included horns/hardware.

function_summary: Feather add-on board that controls brushed DC motors or stepper motors over I2C.
classification_reason: Internal motor-control electronics; does not provide a body structure or actuator.
assembly_notes: Feather controller, motors and external motor supply are separate; header soldering is required.
evidence_note: Vendor specifies four DC motors or two steppers and explicitly excludes Feather and motors.

function_summary: Arduino shield providing DC/stepper motor outputs and hobby-servo connections.
classification_reason: Supports motion electrically; the shield is not a limb or robot chassis.
assembly_notes: Shield kit needs header soldering; Arduino, motors and power supply must be added.
evidence_note: Product page identifies the v3 shield kit and explicitly excludes Arduino and motors.

function_summary: RP2040 development board for embedded programs and peripheral control.
classification_reason: Internal control board; its processor does not make the board a mechanical head.
assembly_notes: Add firmware, power, wiring and suitable interfaces or drivers for external parts.
evidence_note: Vendor distinguishes Pico as an embedded microcontroller rather than a general-purpose Raspberry Pi computer.

function_summary: RP2040 robot-control board with two DC motor channels, servo connections and Grove ports.
classification_reason: Integrates control and power interfaces, not mechanical body parts.
assembly_notes: Motors, servos, sensors, power source and mechanical structure must be supplied separately.
evidence_note: Vendor lists two DC motor channels, four servo connections and onboard power/charging circuitry.

function_summary: VL53L0X optical time-of-flight breakout measuring distance in front of the sensor.
classification_reason: Perception or orientation component; not a physical head assembly.
assembly_notes: Requires host controller, power and mounting; QT cable is separate.
evidence_note: Vendor describes forward ranging, I2C communication and a breakout with voltage regulation/level shifting.

function_summary: Ultrasonic ranging module with HC-SR04-compatible control behavior.
classification_reason: Perception or orientation component; not a physical head assembly.
assembly_notes: Add controller, power, wiring and bracket; vendor notes different physical dimensions from HC-SR04.
evidence_note: Vendor describes ultrasonic distance sensing and operation with 3 V or 5 V systems.

function_summary: BNO085 breakout combining inertial and magnetic sensing with onboard orientation fusion.
classification_reason: Perception or orientation component; not a physical head assembly.
assembly_notes: Requires host, power and a fixed mounting; QT cable is not included.
evidence_note: Vendor identifies accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer and fused orientation output.

function_summary: Two-wheel-drive rover kit providing a metal chassis, drive motors, wheels and support wheel.
classification_reason: Locomotion base fits the legs category; its load-carrying metal body can also serve as a torso in a loose visual build.
assembly_notes: Requires assembly, power, controller and dual H-bridge driver; batteries and Feather boards shown in demos are excluded.
evidence_note: Vendor kit contents list two drive motors, two wheels, support wheel and chassis/top plate; electronics/power are excluded.

function_summary: Silicone-tread wheel that press-fits a TT gearbox motor output.
classification_reason: Individual locomotion component; not a complete leg or driving base.
assembly_notes: Sold individually; TT gearbox motor and chassis are separate.
evidence_note: Vendor specifies one wheel per order and TT-motor-only fit.

function_summary: Rechargeable single-cell lithium-polymer battery with a 2-pin JST-PH lead.
classification_reason: Electrical energy storage belongs to internal power support.
assembly_notes: Battery only; compatible charger and application-specific power regulation are separate.
evidence_note: Vendor identifies 3.7 V nominal, 2500 mAh battery with protection circuitry and preattached connector.
